ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Rogue Op (bare-name collision)
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Live proof for the fully-qualified SafeLeafOps sweep. Ships a C# assembly defining `RogueMod.PatchOperationAdd` — a class with the SAME simple name as Verse.PatchOperationAdd but in a different namespace, applied via Class="RogueMod.PatchOperationAdd" in XML and behaviorally identical to a real Add. Before the fix, RecomputeAllowlist.SafeLeafOps was keyed by bare simple name and would have wrongly trusted this as Verse.PatchOperationAdd; the fully-qualified (Type.FullName) fix must decline it as unknown-op-kind instead. TC_RogueOp_Target is always produced by this op (present in every run); --expect-rogue-op dirties it directly via TestMod_Change (Seed 2) so its producing edge is evaluated by the allowlist. No game content — dev/QA use only.
